title: The Note in the Tube
lines: Jane and Pete hike up to the lake.
Pete finds a tube stuck in the mud.
A note is in it with a map.
"Nine steps from the pine," said Jane.
They dig and dig in the damp sand.
Pete lifts up a white stone.
"Hide it for the next kid," said Jane.
So they did, and left a note in it.

questions.ask: What does Pete find stuck in the mud?
questions.listenFor: A tube, with a note and a map in it.

questions.ask: How do Jane and Pete know where to dig?
questions.listenFor: The map says nine steps from the pine. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: Would you have hidden the stone again, or kept it? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is right. Listen for a reason, such as "hide it, so the next kid gets a turn."
